mapper.select: select from issue_provider_execution_results where adapter_action_id=#{adapterActionId} and attempt_no=#{attemptNo} and observation_kind='EXECUTION'
select from issue_provider_execution_results where adapter_action_id=#{adapterActionId} order by attempt_no desc, created_at desc, result_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update issue_provider_execution_results set projection_status='PROJECTED',projection_attempt_count=projection_attempt_count+1,next_projection_attempt_at=null,last_projection_error=null,projected_at=#{projectedAt},updated_at=now() where result_id=#{resultId} and projection_status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAITING')

update issue_provider_execution_results set projection_status='RETRY_WAITING',projection_attempt_count=#{attemptCount},next_projection_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},last_projection_error=#{error},updated_at=now() where result_id=#{resultId} and projection_status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAITING')

update issue_provider_execution_results set projection_status='FAILED_PERMANENT',projection_attempt_count=#{attemptCount},next_projection_attempt_at=null,last_projection_error=#{error},updated_at=coalesce(#{failedAt},now()) where result_id=#{resultId} and projection_status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAITING')

update issue_provider_execution_results set projection_status='NOT_REQUIRED',next_projection_attempt_at=null,last_projection_error=#{reason},projected_at=#{resolvedAt},updated_at=now() where result_id=#{resultId} and projection_status in ('PENDING','RETRY_WAITING')
